title: 有機合成化学
subtitle: Chemistry of Organic Synthesis
educationalGoal: You learn the organic synthetic chemicals that are necessary not only in chemistry but also in the fields of environment, biology, electronics, etc. You understand properties and reactions and syntheses of alkyl halides, alcohols, phenols, ethers, aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids and their derivatives. You also think about the contribution of organic synthetic chemistry in health, medicine and sanitation.
advice:
In this course, you learn essential concepts to understand modern organic synthetic chemistry.  The aim is to acquire the ability to study the synthesis and the mechanism of organic compounds without a teacher by understanding the contents of the course below,
1. Naming, preparing and reaction of alkyl halides
2. Grignard reaction
3. Nucleophilic substitution reaction
4. Elimination reaction
5. Properties, synthesis and reactions of alcohols, phenols, ethers
6. Nucleophilic addition reactions of aldehydes and ketones.
7. Synthesis and reactions of carboxylic acids and derivative
8. Carbonyl alpha-substitution reaction and condensation reaction.

activityGoals.body: Give IUPAC Name of alkyl halide.
Explain the reaction and synthesis of alcohols, phenols, and ethers.
Explain the substitution reaction by using curved arrows to represent the flow of electrons.
Understand nucleophilic addition reactions of aldehyde and ketone.
Understand reaction of carboxylic acids and derivative.
Understand carbonyl alpha-substitution reactions and condensation reactions.
